name: Milk Junkie 3
source:
Yusuke, the protagonist of the first game who loves big tits, is back. 

After a few years, he ended marrying Mitsuki, the mother of the girl he was tutoring.

Besides a beautiful wife with big tits, now he has a new employment opportunity at the company of the cousin of Mitsuki.

A well-endowed wife waiting him in home, and a well-endowed boss waiting him at workplace. His new married life is about to begin...

[Shorty translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=188101]Getchu[/url]]
